source.description: Post-check payload for a Bash tool that ran `cargo test --workspace`. Pins bug #1 (0.13.2): Claude Code delivers Bash output under `tool_response` (shaped {stdout, stderr, interrupted}), not `tool_output`. The runner asserts `outcome:test_pass` appears on a fresh journal record — impossible if the alias is absent or the output field goes unread.

tool_response.stdout:
running 12 tests
test a ... ok
test result: ok. 12 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 0.01s
